title.zh: 将孔波斯特拉谷省 Pantukan 市镇 Napnapan 描笼涯的 Tambongon 国立中学的 Napnapan 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Tambongon National High School - Napnapan Annex in Barangay Napnapan, Municipality of Pantukan, Province of Compostela Valley From the Tambongon National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Napnapan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Napnapan của Trường Trung học Tambongon Quốc gia tại Barangay Napnapan, Đô thị Pantukan, Tỉnh Compostela Valley khỏi Trường Trung học Tambongon Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Napnapan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Napnapan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tambongon แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Napnapan เทศบาล Pantukan จังหวัด Compostela Valley ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tambongon แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Napnapan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Napnapan, Sekolah Menengah Tambongon Nasional di Barangay Napnapan, Kotamadya Pantukan, Provinsi Compostela Valley dari Sekolah Menengah Tambongon Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Napnapan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Napnapan, Sekolah Menengah Tambongon Kebangsaan di Barangay Napnapan, Perbandaran Pantukan, Wilayah Compostela Valley daripada Sekolah Menengah Tambongon Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Napnapan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Tambongon National High School – Napnapan Annex in Barangay Napnapan, Municipality of Pantukan, Province of Compostela Valley is hereby separated from the Tambongon National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Napnapan National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Tambongon National High School – Napnapan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Napnapan National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Napnapan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Tambongon National High School – Napnapan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
